Stylish text generator

"Stylish text" mostly means "make my name or bio look a bit special", so this page is the full set rather than one look — script, bold, small caps, full-width, circled, the works. A few opinions from using these a lot: for a name (Instagram, Free Fire, PUBG, a Discord handle), the cleaner styles win — bold, full-width, small caps — because they stay legible and they pass most name filters. For a bio, script and small caps feel intentional; loading every effect onto one line just looks busy. If you're after symbols around your name (the ✦彡 kind of decoration), that's a separate trick from changing the letterforms — combine a clean letter style here with a symbol or two and you've got it. Everything's real Unicode, so it pastes into the usual places, with the usual asterisk that the pickiest username fields reject the fancier glyphs.

How to use it

Type in the box on the left. The style you’ve picked on the right updates as you type — no “generate” button. Click Copy and paste it wherever you need. On the home page you can also browse every style in the list below and click any row to load it into the panel.

App / platformWhereStatusNotes
Instagram / TikTok biobio, captionsWorksAlmost any style works here. Script and small caps read the most "deliberate"; circled and full-width also fine.

All of these are real Unicode characters, not images or font files, so the styling travels with the text wherever you paste it. The catch: a few apps with locked-down fonts will draw some glyphs as empty boxes — that's the receiving app, not the text, and switching styles fixes it. Bold (sans), Small Caps and Full-width render the widest. Checked May 2026; platforms change their font handling constantly, so treat the table below as a strong guide, not a guarantee. The full cross-app compatibility page goes wider.

Examples & use cases

Stylish where it counts:

  • Free Fire / PUBG / Mobile Legends name — Bold sans or Full-width — legible at small sizes, passes most game filters. Add one symbol on each side if you want decoration; don't stack effects.
  • Instagram bio name — 𝓪𝓵𝓮𝔁 in script reads personal; ᴀʟᴇx in small caps reads clean and typeset. Either beats a bio crammed with glitch marks.
  • Discord display name — Discord renders almost anything in nicknames, so this is the one place the decorative styles really shine.
  • Symbols around your name — Those ✦ ⟡ ☆ symbols are separate characters — style your name with a clean letter set here, then add a symbol on each side. One style + one or two symbols looks far better than five effects.
  • A username that needs to actually save — If a name keeps bouncing, the filter is rejecting non-ASCII. Switch to Bold sans — it's the style most likely to go through.

Common mistakes

  • Don't pile on effects. Bold + glitch + circled + spacing on one name reads as cluttered, not stylish. One strong style, optionally one symbol on each side. That's the look people actually like.
  • Don't use decorative styles in a game username. Most game name filters reject anything beyond common characters. Bold sans, Full-width and Small Caps are the ones that pass — start there.
  • Don't assume the bio style works in the @username. Bios are permissive; the username/@handle field is the strictest field on any platform. Test in the bio; the handle will likely reject most of it.
  • Don't confuse 'stylish text' with 'stylish symbols'. Changing letterforms (this page) and adding decorative symbols around your name are two different things. You usually want both — but apply them separately.

FAQ

What's the best stylish font for a game name?
Bold sans or full-width — they read clearly at small sizes and they get past most game name filters. Small caps is a good third option. The heavily decorated styles often get rejected in the actual username field even when they look great in a profile.
How do I get those symbols around my name?
Those come from symbol/emoji characters, not from restyling the letters. Style your name with one of the rows here, then add a symbol on each side. Mixing one clean letter style with one or two symbols looks far better than piling on effects.
Stylish text vs. fancy text — is there a difference?
Not really — they're the same idea and largely the same character sets. "Stylish name generator", "fancy text generator", "cool fonts" all land in the same place.
Will it work on Free Fire / PUBG / Mobile Legends?
The clean styles usually pass — bold, full-width, small caps. The glitch and stacked-mark styles often don't make it through those games' name filters. If a name bounces, switch to bold and try again.
Why does my stylish name show as boxes for some teammates?
Their device or game client is missing those glyphs. It's not broken on your end. Bold sans and Small Caps box out the least — pick those if you want the widest compatibility.
Can I save a stylish name and reuse it?
Yes — copy it once and it's just text; paste it wherever, whenever. On this site you can also pin your favorite styles so they sit at the top of the list next visit.
